# Kilo Code Documentation

Kilo Code is an open-source VS Code extension that accelerates development with AI-driven code generation and task automation.

## Overview

Kilo Code is an all-in-one agentic engineering platform that helps developers:
- Generate code from natural language descriptions
- Refactor and debug existing code
- Write and update documentation
- Answer questions about codebases
- Automate repetitive tasks
- Create new files and projects

### Modes
Kilo Code provides specialized modes for different tasks:
- Code Mode: For general-purpose coding tasks
- Architect Mode: For planning and technical leadership
- Ask Mode: For answering questions and providing information
- Debug Mode: For systematic problem diagnosis

The Kilo CLI can be used independently of VS Code:
